headline: Municipality of Lima reverses full powers granted to city prosecutor
subheadline: Provincial Prosecutor now requires council approval before filing lawsuits.
content: The Municipality of Lima has reversed its previous stance allowing the City Prosecutor unrestricted authority to file legal actions against alleged corruption cases during prior administrations without consulting the Council. Previously, this power was given following a session held on January 8 where broad authorities were assigned directly to the City Prosecutor.

headline: Court orders preventive detention for former minister's wife linked to bribery case
subheadline: Former infrastructure minister investigated again due to ties with company involved in wiretap evidence.
content: Today, after investigations initiated by the Public Ministry regarding allegations involving Mayor Francis Solari of Magdalena District, several inquiries have been conducted across various institutions seeking information about the burgess master. Additionally, the Anti-Money Laundering Prosecution Office filed a complaint arguing insufficient investigation efforts made by the provincial court which had previously dismissed the case based on findings related to intercepted phone calls between the accused party and business entities.

headline: ¿Ese 20% o 25% que, según las encuestas, apoya a Maduro es un aduladora?

headline: Hernán Migoya / Sexo.21
subheadline: LAS HERMANAS DEL RÍO DAN UN PASO ADELANTÉ
author: Patricia y María Luisa del Río
content: Retratos por la igualdad. Alicia y María Luisa del Río han hecho del periodismo y la literatura sus respectivas trincheras. Ahora firman juntas ‘Hey, soy gay’ (Planeta), un volumen que recoge 20 entrevistas a 19 identidades peruanas que se declaran abiertamente homosexuales (algunas por primera vez en público) y una transexual: un hombre heterosexual nacido mujer.

headline: NUEVO CAPÍTULO EN CASO CHAMPY JALISCO
content: Solo diez agentes de la Policía patrullan calles de Barranco. Asaltos a mano armada en diversos negocios se han incrementado en los últimos meses. Cena en un concurrido restaurant de Barranco o recorre sus tradicionales calles se ha convertido ahora en un riesgo debido al incremento de la delincuencia en ese distrito.

headline: Murió tras ser arrollado por bus urbano
content: Diez mil papeletas tenía el chofer Julio Chaplin Fernández (35) y, aun así, condujo un autobús de una ruta alimentadora del Metropolitano. La tarde del lunes, debido a un aparente exceso de velocidad, arrolló y mató a Bruno Champi Jalisco (73).
